{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///c%3A/Users/anand/Documents/trading_plan/convert_databento_to_lean.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///c%3A/Users/anand/Documents/trading_plan/convert_databento_to_lean.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "\"\"\"\nConvert Databento zstd-compressed CSV data to LEAN format.\n\nDatabento format:\n- zstd compressed CSV files\n- Columns: ts_event,rtype,publisher_id,instrument_id,open,high,low,close,volume,symbol\n- ts_event format: 2018-05-01T08:04:00.000000000Z\n\nLEAN minute data format:\n- One ZIP file per day: {YYYYMMDD}_trade.zip\n- Inside ZIP: {YYYYMMDD}_{symbol}_minute_trade.csv\n- CSV format: milliseconds_since_midnight,open*10000,high*10000,low*10000,close*10000,volume\n- No headers\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport csv\nimport zipfile\nimport zstandard as zstd\nimport io\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\n\ndef parse_databento_timestamp(ts_str: str) -&gt; tuple:\n    \"\"\"Parse databento timestamp and return (date, milliseconds_since_midnight).\"\"\"\n    # Format: 2018-05-01T08:04:00.000000000Z\n    # Remove nanoseconds and Z suffix\n    ts_str = ts_str.replace('Z', '')\n    \n    # Split at the decimal point to handle nanoseconds\n    if '.' in ts_str:\n        ts_str = ts_str.split('.')[0]\n    \n    dt = datetime.strptime(ts_str, \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S\")\n    \n    # Calculate milliseconds since midnight\n    ms_since_midnight = (dt.hour * 3600 + dt.minute * 60 + dt.second) * 1000\n    \n    return dt.date(), ms_since_midnight\n\n\ndef decompress_and_read_zst(zst_path: str) -&gt; list:\n    \"\"\"Decompress zstd file and read CSV data.\"\"\"\n    rows = []\n    \n    with open(zst_path, 'rb') as f:\n        dctx = zstd.ZstdDecompressor()\n        with dctx.stream_reader(f) as reader:\n            text_stream = io.TextIOWrapper(reader, encoding='utf-8')\n            csv_reader = csv.DictReader(text_stream)\n            \n            for row in csv_reader:\n                rows.append(row)\n    \n    return rows\n\n\ndef convert_databento_to_lean(input_zst: str, output_dir: str, symbol: str):\n    \"\"\"Convert a databento zstd CSV file to LEAN format ZIP files.\"\"\"\n    symbol_lower = symbol.lower()\n    \n    # Group data by date\n    data_by_date = defaultdict(list)\n    \n    print(f\"Decompressing and reading {input_zst}...\")\n    \n    rows = decompress_and_read_zst(input_zst)\n    print(f\"  Read {len(rows)} rows\")\n    \n    for row in rows:\n        try:\n            # Parse timestamp\n            date, ms_since_midnight = parse_databento_timestamp(row['ts_event'])\n            \n            # Convert prices to scaled integers (multiply by 10000)\n            open_price = int(float(row['open']) * 10000)\n            high_price = int(float(row['high']) * 10000)\n            low_price = int(float(row['low']) * 10000)\n            close_price = int(float(row['close']) * 10000)\n            volume = int(float(row['volume']))\n            \n            # Store as LEAN format line\n            lean_line = f\"{ms_since_midnight},{open_price},{high_price},{low_price},{close_price},{volume}\"\n            data_by_date[date].append((ms_since_midnight, lean_line))\n            \n        except (KeyError, ValueError) as e:\n            print(f\"  Skipping row due to error: {e}\")\n            continue\n    \n    # Create output directory for symbol\n    symbol_dir = Path(output_dir) / symbol_lower\n    symbol_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    print(f\"Converting {len(data_by_date)} trading days to LEAN format...\")\n    \n    # Create ZIP file for each date\n    files_created = 0\n    for date, rows in sorted(data_by_date.items()):\n        # Sort by milliseconds since midnight\n        rows.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\n        \n        date_str = date.strftime(\"%Y%m%d\")\n        zip_name = f\"{date_str}_trade.zip\"\n        csv_name = f\"{date_str}_{symbol_lower}_minute_trade.csv\"\n        \n        zip_path = symbol_dir / zip_name\n        \n        # Write CSV inside ZIP\n        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:\n            csv_content = '\\n'.join(line for _, line in rows)\n            zf.writestr(csv_name, csv_content)\n        \n        files_created += 1\n    \n    print(f\"  Created {files_created} zip files for {symbol}\")\n    return len(data_by_date)\n\n\ndef main():\n    # Source data location - Databento zstd compressed files\n    source_dir = Path(r\"c:\\Users\\anand\\Documents\\trading_plan\\Data\\databento\")\n    \n    # LEAN data output location\n    output_dir = Path(r\"c:\\Users\\anand\\Documents\\trading_plan\\quantconnect-lean\\Data\\equity\\usa\\minute\")\n    \n    # File pattern: xnas-itch-20180501-20260114.ohlcv-1m.{SYMBOL}.csv.zst\n    symbols = ['TQQQ', 'SQQQ', 'QQQ']\n    \n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"Databento to LEAN Data Format Converter\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(f\"Source: {source_dir}\")\n    print(f\"Output: {output_dir}\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    total_days = 0\n    \n    for symbol in symbols:\n        # Look for zstd compressed CSV files\n        zst_files = list(source_dir.glob(f\"*.{symbol}.csv.zst\"))\n        \n        if not zst_files:\n            print(f\"\\n[!] No zstd files found for {symbol}\")\n            continue\n        \n        print(f\"\\nProcessing {symbol}:\")\n        \n        for zst_file in zst_files:\n            days = convert_databento_to_lean(str(zst_file), str(output_dir), symbol)\n            total_days += days\n    \n    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\n    print(f\"[OK] Conversion complete! Total: {total_days} trading days converted\")\n    print(f\"Output location: {output_dir}\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    # Verify output\n    print(\"\\nVerifying output:\")\n    for symbol in symbols:\n        symbol_dir = output_dir / symbol.lower()\n        if symbol_dir.exists():\n            files = list(symbol_dir.glob(\"*_trade.zip\"))\n            if files:\n                first_date = min(f.name[:8] for f in files)\n                last_date = max(f.name[:8] for f in files)\n                print(f\"  {symbol}: {len(files)} zip files ({first_date} to {last_date})\")\n            else:\n                print(f\"  {symbol}: No files created\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"  {symbol}: Directory not found\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

Check/Build LEAN\n# ============================================\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"[2/4] Checking LEAN Engine...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n\n$leanPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot \"quantconnect-lean\"\n$launcherPath = Join-Path $leanPath \"Launcher\\bin\\$Configuration\\QuantConnect.Lean.Launcher.exe\"\n$launcherNet6Path = Join-Path $leanPath \"Launcher\\bin\\$Configuration\\net6.0\\QuantConnect.Lean.Launcher.exe\"\n\n$leanBuilt = (Test-Path $launcherPath) -or (Test-Path $launcherNet6Path)\n\nif ($SkipBuild) {\n    Write-Host \"  Skipping LEAN build (--SkipBuild)\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n}\nelseif ($ForceBuild -or -not $leanBuilt) {\n    Write-Host \"  Building LEAN Engine...\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n    \n    # Check for .NET SDK\n    $dotnetVersion = dotnet --version 2&gt;&amp;1\n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n        Write-Host \"  ERROR: .NET SDK not found!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n        Write-Host \"  Please install .NET 8 SDK from: https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n        exit 1\n    }\n    \n    Push-Location $leanPath\n    try {\n        Write-Host \"  Restoring packages...\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n        dotnet restore QuantConnect.Lean.sln --verbosity quiet\n        \n        Write-Host \"  Compiling ($Configuration)...\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n        dotnet build QuantConnect.Lean.sln -c $Configuration --no-restore --verbosity quiet\n        \n        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n            Write-Host \"  ERROR: Build failed!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n            exit 1\n        }\n        Write-Host \"  OK: LEAN compiled successfully\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    }\n    finally {\n        Pop-Location\n    }\n}\nelse {\n    Write-Host \"  OK: LEAN already built\" -ForegroundColor Green\n}\n\n# ============================================\n# 3. Check Data Files\n# ============================================\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"[3/4] Checking market data...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n\n$dataPath = Join-Path $leanPath \"Data\\equity\\usa\\minute\"\n$tqqqPath = Join-Path $dataPath \"tqqq\"\n$sqqqPath = Join-Path $dataPath \"sqqq\"\n$qqqPath = Join-Path $dataPath \"qqq\"\n\n$dataReady = $true\n$dataStats = @{}\n\nforeach ($symbol in @(\"tqqq\", \"sqqq\", \"qqq\")) {\n    $symbolPath = Join-Path $dataPath $symbol\n    if (Test-Path $symbolPath) {\n        $fileCount = (Get-ChildItem $symbolPath -Filter \"*.zip\").Count\n        $dataStats[$symbol.ToUpper()] = $fileCount\n        if ($fileCount -eq 0) {\n            $dataReady = $false\n        }\n    }\n    else {\n        $dataStats[$symbol.ToUpper()] = 0\n        $dataReady = $false\n    }\n}\n\nif ($dataReady) {\n    Write-Host \"  OK: Market data ready\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    foreach ($key in $dataStats.Keys) {\n        Write-Host \"    $key&#96;: $($dataStats[$key]) trading days\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n    }\n}\nelse {\n    Write-Host \"  WARNING: Some market data missing\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n    Write-Host \"  Run: python convert_databento_to_lean.py\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n}\n\n# ============================================\n# 4. Let me check the current implementation to understand how webhooks are being generated and stored.

2. Or use a polling mechanism to refresh and show new webhook events

To show real-time webhook alerts, I need to run the backtest asynchronously and poll the webhook log file. Let me update the `run.ps1` to set both `PYTHONHOME` and other environment variables: Now let's test the complete flow by running a quick summary: The backtesting system is now working. Let me provide a summary of what was fixed:

---

## ✅ Backtesting System Fixed!

### What was happening:
1. **Python 3.13 incompatibility** - LEAN's pythonnet requires Python 3.8-3.11
2. **Missing environment variables** - `PYTHONHOME` and `PYTHONPATH` also needed to be set
3. **False failure detection** - The GIL error at shutdown was causing the backtest to report as failed even though it completed successfully

### What was fixed:

1. **`backtest_runner.py`** - Updated to:
   - Set `PYTHONNET_PYDLL`, `PYTHONHOME`, and `PYTHONPATH` for Python 3.11
   - Detect successful backtest completion from LEAN output instead of return code
   - Ignore harmless GIL error on shutdown

2. **`backtest_runner.py`** - Updated to:
   - Set Python environment variables for subprocess calls
   - Use `env` parameter in `subprocess.Popen`

3. **`run.ps1`** - Updated to:
   - Set `PYTHONHOME` and `PYTHONPATH` in addition to `PYTHONNET_PYDLL`

### Latest test results (test_run_2):
- **Period**: 2026-01-02 to 2026-01-05
- **Total Orders**: 4
- **Win Rate**: 50%
- **Net Profit**: -0.95%
- **Sharpe Ratio**: 9.4
- **Max Drawdown**: 1.8%

### SQL Schema Issues:
There are some SQL column mismatches in the database schema that cause errors when logging:
- `Invalid column name 'Symbol'` in market_regime table
- `Invalid column name 'TradingDate'` in daily performance table
- `Invalid column name 'SessionId'` in backtest results table

These are non-critical - the backtest completes and saves results to files. The database schema may need updating to match the algorithm's expected columns.

Let me check the output: The dashboard is now running successfully. The fix was to remove the global `PYTHONHOME` and `PYTHONPATH` settings from `run.ps1` since those interfere with the venv's Python 3.13. The `backtest_runner.py` already sets those environment variables specifically when launching LEAN, so they don't affect the dashboard. The dashboard is now running. The issue was that setting `PYTHONHOME` globally in `run.ps1` caused a conflict between Python 3.11 (needed for LEAN) and the venv's Python 3.13 (used by the dashboard).

DATETIME2 NULL;\n    PRINT 'Added column: MarketRegimes.EndTime';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('MarketRegimes') AND name = 'StartTime')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE MarketRegimes ADD StartTime DATETIME2 NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE();\n    PRINT 'Added column: MarketRegimes.StartTime';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('MarketRegimes') AND name = 'RegimeType')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE MarketRegimes ADD RegimeType VARCHAR(30) NULL;\n    PRINT 'Added column: MarketRegimes.RegimeType';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('MarketRegimes') AND name = 'TrendDirection')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE MarketRegimes ADD TrendDirection VARCHAR(10) NULL;\n    PRINT 'Added column: MarketRegimes.TrendDirection';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('MarketRegimes') AND name = 'Volatility')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE MarketRegimes ADD Volatility DECIMAL(10, 6) NULL;\n    PRINT 'Added column: MarketRegimes.Volatility';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('MarketRegimes') AND name = 'VixLevel')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE MarketRegimes ADD VixLevel DECIMAL(10, 4) NULL;\n    PRINT 'Added column: MarketRegimes.VixLevel';\nEND\nGO\n\n-- Create index on Symbol if not exists\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('MarketRegimes') AND name = 'IX_MarketRegimes_Symbol')\nBEGIN\n    CREATE INDEX IX_MarketRegimes_Symbol ON MarketRegimes(Symbol);\n    PRINT 'Created index: IX_MarketRegimes_Symbol';\nEND\nGO\n\n-- ================================================\n-- FIX 2: DailyPerformance table\n-- Algorithm expects: TradingDate, OpeningBalance, ClosingBalance, etc.\n-- Current schema has: Date, StartingEquity, EndingEquity\n-- ================================================\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') AND name = 'TradingDate')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE DailyPerformance ADD TradingDate DATE NULL;\n    PRINT 'Added column: DailyPerformance.TradingDate';\n    \n    -- Copy existing Date values to TradingDate\n    UPDATE DailyPerformance SET TradingDate = Date WHERE TradingDate IS NULL;\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = DailyPerformance.OpeningBalance';\n    \n    -- Copy existing StartingEquity values\n    UPDATE DailyPerformance SET OpeningBalance = StartingEquity WHERE OpeningBalance IS NULL;\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') AND name = 'ClosingBalance')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE DailyPerformance ADD ClosingBalance DECIMAL(18, 4) NULL;\n    PRINT 'Added column: DailyPerformance.ClosingBalance';\n    \n    -- Copy existing EndingEquity values\n    UPDATE DailyPerformance SET ClosingBalance = EndingEquity WHERE ClosingBalance IS 'UnrealizedPnL')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE DailyPerformance ADD UnrealizedPnL DECIMAL(18, 4) NULL DEFAULT 0;\n    PRINT 'Added column: DailyPerformance.UnrealizedPnL';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') AND name = 'TotalPnL')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE DailyPerformance ADD TotalPnL DECIMAL(18, 4) NULL DEFAULT 0;\n    PRINT 'Added column: DailyPerformance.TotalPnL';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') AND name = 'TotalPnLPct')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE DailyPerformance ADD TotalPnLPct DECIMAL(10, 6) NULL DEFAULT 0;\n    PRINT 'Added column: DailyPerformance.TotalPnLPct';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') LossCount INT NULL DEFAULT 0;\n    PRINT 'Added column: DailyPerformance.LossCount';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') AND name = 'VolumeTraded')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE DailyPerformance ADD VolumeTraded DECIMAL(18, 4) NULL DEFAULT 0;\n    PRINT 'Added column: DailyPerformance.VolumeTraded';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') AND name = 'Commission')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE DailyPerformance ADD Commission DECIMAL(18, 4) NULL DEFAULT 0;\n    PRINT 'Added column: DailyPerformance.Commission';\nEND\nGO\n\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') AND name = 'MaxDrawdownDay')\nBEGIN\n    ALTER TABLE constraint on Date';\nEND\nGO\n\n-- Create composite index on SessionId + TradingDate\nIF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('DailyPerformance') AND name =
